themeAndObservationPreconditions: Wait for real page hydration and document.fonts.ready; verify section belongs to intended TEAM and real session/tenant remains unchanged

Assert html effective light state and absence of dashboard wallpaper for this explicitly bounded default fixture. Record actual html class, colorScheme, forced-colors media, device scale and nearest force-light presence. Do not mutate DOM classes/theme/localStorage/CSS to improve the result

Read actual computed styles after bounded stable samples; active/focus-visible/hover/disabled flags recorded. The initial lane covers normal/native-focused enabled text; hover/pressed transient states are not separately credited

paintAndColorHandling.foreground: Read computed color and text-fill color from the actual parent of every rendered text run; inherited paragraph styles must not hide differently styled descendants. Exclude SVG/icon-only nodes from text count
paintAndColorHandling.background: Start from text owner and compose alpha background-color layers over nearest actual opaque ancestor; retain the chain. Walk all ancestors through document root for effects even after finding an opaque background. Account for target-owned background before parent backdrop
paintAndColorHandling.alpha: Straight foreground/background RGBA alpha compositing in supported sRGB paint model; foreground color alpha is separate from CSS group opacity. Never multiply ancestor opacity naively and call that rendered contrast
paintAndColorHandling.opacity: Small initial lane requires computed opacity=1 on target and every ancestor. Any non-unit group opacity is unsupported/fatal, with measured reason; implement correct group/backdrop compositing only if the actual diagnostic proves that is necessary
paintAndColorHandling.unsupported: Any background-image/gradient, blend mode other than normal, filter/backdrop-filter/mask, relevant pseudo-element overlay, unresolvable backdrop/text-fill, or unsupported color space must produce explicit diagnostic failure/NOT PROVEN, never skip or automatic PASS. Do not assume body white or use the nearest transparent color alone
paintAndColorHandling.colorFormats: Collect raw computed strings first. Normalize only explicitly supported resolved RGB/RGBA or color(srgb) values with validated numeric ranges. If Chromium reports OKLCH/other spaces, do not reinterpret them as RGB: add a deterministic validated CSS Color conversion or conservative browser-conversion bounds before acceptance. A preliminary UNSUPPORTED result is a harness proof gap, not an inferred UI defect
paintAndColorHandling.noScreenshotSampling: Do not calculate from anti-aliased glyph PNG pixels or guess from CSS comments/screenshots. If a browser color-normalization probe is used, keep it off-DOM and record sRGB conversion/precision; ambiguous threshold bounds are FAIL/NOT PROVEN
paintAndColorHandling.stability: No outstanding font load or animating color/opacity transition at observation; use bounded repeated computed reads and fail if unsettled rather than raising tolerance

thresholdsAndMath.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC1.4.3 Contrast Minimum (AA), scoped text targets only
thresholdsAndMath.largeTextRule: 24 CSS px or greater; or at least 18.666666666666668 CSS px with confirmed bold weight >=700. Semibold600 does not receive the lower threshold; unknown font metrics/weight conservatively retain4.5
thresholdsAndMath.fontEvidence: Record computed font-size, numeric font-weight, font-family, text run identity and threshold for every target; current source classes do not establish runtime metrics
thresholdsAndMath.relativeLuminance: For normalized sRGB channel c, use c/12.92 when c<=0.04045, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B
thresholdsAndMath.comparison: Compare unrounded ratio >= exact threshold; no display rounding, epsilon or color-estimate exception can turn a below-threshold ratio into PASS
thresholdsAndMath.inactive: Pending genuinely disabled buttons may be identified as outside the enabled-text requirement, but expected enabled confirm/cancel/source records are still mandatory; no inactive exemption for hints/notices
thresholdsAndMath.scopeLimits: No overall WCAG compliance, non-text/focus-ring contrast, hover/pressed states, dark theme, forced colors, native zoom, assistive technology or whole-page acceptance claim

diagnosticIntegrity: Preserve exact first hosted receipt even on FAIL, plus run/job/artifact/head/synthetic parents/digest and actual phase PNGs

Record target key/locale/phase, rendered text length or expected-match flags, resolved colors, backdrop chain, font, state, ratio/threshold and supported/failure reasons; do not collect credentials/business payloads
